# vaultwarden_organization_api_key_rotation (Resource)

Rotates the API key of an organization: creating the resource, or replacing it when `triggers` change, gives the organization a new client secret and invalidates the old one. The secret is not stored: read it with the `vaultwarden_organization_api_key` ephemeral resource.

Destroying the resource leaves the current key unchanged. Rotating requires the provider user's master password and, on Vaultwarden 1.37 and later, the `Owner` role in the organization (1.36 also allows `Admin`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vaultwarden_organization" "example" {
  name = "Example Organization"
}

# Rotate the key every 90 days
resource "time_rotating" "example" {
  rotation_days = 90
}

resource "vaultwarden_organization_api_key_rotation" "example" {
  organization_id = vaultwarden_organization.example.id

  triggers = {
    rotation = time_rotating.example.id
  }
}

# Read the key after it was rotated
ephemeral "vaultwarden_organization_api_key" "example" {
  organization_id = vaultwarden_organization_api_key_rotation.example.organization_id

  depends_on = [vaultwarden_organization_api_key_rotation.example]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String) ID of the organization. Changing it rotates the key of the new organization.

### Optional

- `triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary values that rotate the key again when they change, for example the `id` of a `time_rotating` resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the organization.
- `revision_date` (String) When the API key was last rotated.
